title: `gauntlet pending` command
goal: List new, changed and stale cases of the given packs against a ledger, for any consumer
acceptance: Classifies each case: new (no entry), changed (hash differs), stale (older than --max-age), identity mismatch (requested profile differs), current
Human and --json output; exit 1 when anything is pending, 0 otherwise
No knowledge of any consumer; packs and ledger paths are arguments
validation: Fixtures: new pack, changed case, unchanged case, stale entry, other profile; npm test; release 0.6.0 after green CI
escalation: Default max age is the consumer’s setting, not Gauntlet’s

effort.basis: Owner decision 2026-11-11: Gauntlet and the harness are reused by future projects, so the generic part of 'a pack added or changed raises a run' lives here; consumers keep their ledger, rule and budgets. Estimate, not a measurement.

privacy: Metadata only: identities, hashes, dates; no outputs, prompts or credentials.
